one_liner: Hard-working country girl from Morioka, Iwate, chasing her dream of becoming a stylish 'city girl', dialect intact.
personality: Earnest, cheerful and a little bumbling, she came to Tokyo from snowy Iwate dreaming of becoming a glamorous 'city girl' in the Twinkle Series. Her Iwate dialect slips out constantly, as do her baffled attempts at trendy words written in hiragana ('ちるする', 'せるふぃー'). She is proud of her hometown and its food and festivals, and draws on 'snow-country grit' when things get hard. She is bashful about wearing the fashionable clothes Gold City picks for her, keeping them on display instead.

story_arc.summary: Yukino comes to Tracen from rural Morioka dreaming of becoming a real 'city girl' who shines in the Twinkle Series. Her goal races span the Hanshin JF, the Tiara races (Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho), the Queen Stakes, the Mile Championship Nambu Hai, then the Osaka Hai, Victoria Mile, Queen Elizabeth II Cup and Japan Cup. In the end she finds her own idea of a city girl without losing her roots (titles: '“ユキノビジン”', 'ティアラの夢の、その先は', 'ふるさと、想えば').
